name: Document Loader Plugin - API Tool
description: Provides a Tool plugin for loading documents from API endpoints.
project_description: Opt-in submodule of document_loader_plugin_api. It registers a single Tool-API plugin (id document_loader_from_api, class DocumentLoaderTool extending Drupal\tool\Tool\ToolBase) so AI agents and other Tool consumers can load documents from HTTP/HTTPS API endpoints and receive them in a chosen output format. The tool is declared with the #[Tool] attribute (operation ToolOperation::Read) and accepts location (endpoint URL), and optional output_format, http_method, request_body, and request_headers inputs; it returns content and format outputs. On execution it inspects the location's scheme (only http/https proceed) and a lightweight heuristic (method != GET, a request body/headers present, or a URL that looks like an API), then instantiates the parent module's document_loader:api plugin via plugin.manager.document_loader and calls load() with an ApiInput built from the caller's URL, method, decoded JSON headers, and body. Access is granted to any authenticated user (checkAccess returns AccessResult::allowedIf($account->isAuthenticated())). It depends on the parent document_loader_plugin_api module and the tool module, and ships no routes, permissions, configuration, or services of its own.
